notes: The six-model family has 6 RQ1, 18 RQ2 and 6 RQ3 comparisons; all q-values are computed together from fresh current-release responses.
The two Qwen evaluators are from the same Qwen3 generation: Qwen3-32B and Qwen3-235B-A22B. Qwen3-8B is excluded.
All six evaluators run at 69 workers, matching the highest concurrency used by the previous roster.
The model roster matches scripts/run_roster.sh. Any roster change must be explicit before rescoring.
Extractive and atomic coverage checks are separate diagnostics, not additional tests silently inserted into this family.
